zh: Mary Tudor (1516-58) the queen of England and Ireland from 1553 to 1558. She was the daughter of King Henry VIII and Catherine of Aragon, and became queen after the death of King Edward VI. Among her first acts as queen was the execution of Lady Jane Grey, who also had a claim to be queen. Mary was determined to bring back Roman Catholicism to England, and married the Catholic Philip II of Spain in 1554. Many Protestants opposed this, and she ordered hundreds of them to be burned to death, for which she became known as 'Bloody Mary'. Among those who died in this way were Thomas Cranmer and Hugh Latimer. Mary had no children, and after her death she was replaced by her half-sister (= sister by a different mother) Elizabeth I.

zh: Mary Stuart (1542-87) the queen of Scotland from 1542 to 1567. She was the daughter of King James V of Scotland and the cousin of Queen Elizabeth I, and became queen of Scotland soon after her birth. She did not rule Scotland until 1561 and was instead brought up in France, where she was queen briefly in 1559. She was a Roman Catholic, and after her return to Scotland became involved in religious disputes with Scottish Protestants. In 1567 she was forced to give up power in favour of her son James VI (later King James I of England), and moved to England where she was held as a prisoner. In the years that followed there were several attempts by Catholic groups to make her queen of England in place of Elizabeth I, and Elizabeth finally ordered Mary's head to be cut off. zh: 马塔图小巴士（肯尼亚的一种私营公交车，车身上常涂有彩绘图案或文字）
en: (in Kenya) a small, privately owned bus, often decorated with pictures, words or phrases, that carries passengers and has a driver that you pay to take you somewhere, usually along a fixed route with other stops for people to get on and off

zh: 相配的人（或物）；般配的人（或物）
相同的东西；非常相似的东西
en: a sports event where people or teams compete against each other
ex: a football match
足球比赛

en: to compare something with something else in order to find things that are the same or similar
ex: New information is matched against existing data in the computer.
新的资料和电脑中已有的数据作了比较。

zh: a British television programme that shows details of the most important football matches of a particular day (usually a Saturday). It first appeared in 1964, and its presenters have included David Coleman, Desmond Lynam and Gary Lineker.
en: a British television programme that shows details of the most important football matches of a particular day (usually a Saturday). It first appeared in 1964, and its presenters have included David Coleman, Desmond Lynam and Gary Lineker.

zh: （高尔夫球）比洞赛（与比杆赛有别）
en: a way of playing golf in which your score depends on the number of holes that you win rather than the number of times you hit the ball in the whole game
a point that, if won by a player, will also win them the match
to be as good, interesting, successful as somebody/something
ex: The trip failed to match up to her expectations.
这次旅行令她很失望。

en: to arrange for somebody to compete in a game or competition against somebody else
ex: We are matched against last year's champions in the first round.
我们第一轮即遭遇了去年的冠军。

zh: （体育运动）操纵比赛，比赛造假
en: (in sport) the act of deciding in a way that is not honest what the result of a particular game will be before it is played
ex: Several countries have suffered soccer match-fixing scandals.
有几个国家陷入了足球假球丑闻。

zh: a type of green tea from Japan, made of leaves crushed into a powder
en: a type of green tea from Japan, made of leaves crushed into a powder
ex: Matcha is a special tea renowned for its many health benefits.
抹茶是一种特殊茶，因具有许多健康益处而闻名。

en: a piece of folded card containing matches and a surface to light them on
